title: SKAM edu extension value (urn:skam:edu:1)
description: The value of ext.edu on a mark. skam.schema.json applies it only to the ten mark types that can carry a quiz mark, and only in a document whose extensions lists "edu". Mirrors the validator in @kanbun-skam/skam; the validator is the source of truth. quiz is 1 to 64 code points, without the control characters U+0000 to U+001F and U+007F to U+009F.
